criteria.criterion: A container whose non-closed direct children all declare non-empty file_impact signs a dependency set equal to own file_impact ∪ citations ∪ the children's union — asserted by parsing dep lines from the signed manifest in an interface test.

Poison rule: if any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, the signed set is unchanged from pre-change behavior (empty ⇒ whole-HEAD fallback applies) — asserted by manifest inspection plus a claim blocked after an unrelated commit.
Closed children neither contribute paths nor poison the union — asserted with a fixture containing one closed impact-less child.

With inheritance effective: an unrelated committed change does NOT invalidate the container attestation (claim succeeds); a committed change to a child-declared file DOES (claim blocked, reason names drift) — both asserted via rebar.claim.
A child editing its file_impact after the container review invalidates the container's attestation (pin/material drift) — asserted via claim_gate_check.
P9: a container with poisoned inheritance yields an advisory naming the offending child id(s); a container with effective inheritance passes; leaf behavior is unchanged — asserted in DET-floor tests.
docs/plan-review-gate.md and ADR 0002 describe container inheritance and the poison rule.
